title: Tensor computing application programming interface: An application-oriented, lightweight API for portable high-performance tensor network computations
abstract: arXiv:2512.23917v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tensor networks (TNs) are a central computational tool in quantum science and artificial intelligence. However, the lack of a unified software interface across tensor-computing frameworks severely limits the portability of TN applications, coupling algorithmic development to specific hardware and software back ends. To address this challenge, we introduce the Tensor Computing Application Programming Interface (TCAPI)---an application-oriented, lightweight API designed to enable framework-independent, high-performance TN applications, currently specified for \texttt{C++} and \texttt{Python}. TCAPI provides well-defined type-system conventions that abstract tensor objects, together with a minimal yet expressive set of core functions for essential tensor manipulations and tensor linear-algebra operations, with operation semantics shared across language specifications. translated_title: 张量计算应用程序编程接口（TCAPI）：一种面向应用的、轻量级的可移植高性能张量网络计算API
translated_abstract: 张量网络（TNs）是量子科学和人工智能领域的核心计算工具。然而，缺乏跨张量计算框架的统一软件接口严重限制了TN应用程序的可移植性，使算法开发与特定的硬件和软件后端紧密耦合。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了张量计算应用程序编程接口（TCAPI）——一个面向应用的轻量级API，旨在实现与框架无关的高性能张量网络应用，目前已为C++和Python两种语言制定了规范。TCAPI提供了明确定义的类型系统约定以抽象化张量对象，并配备了一套精简而富有表现力的核心函数集，用于基本的张量操作和张量线性代数运算，且操作语义在两种语言规范之间保持共享一致。通过对代表性张量网络应用的数值演示（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了TCAPI——一个面向应用的轻量级编程接口，通过抽象张量对象和定义C++/Python间语义共享的精简核心函数集，实现了跨框架、跨硬件的可移植高性能张量网络计算。
en_tdlr: TCAPI, an application-oriented and lightweight API with abstracted tensor objects and a minimal set of core functions sharing semantics across C++ and Python, enables portable, framework-independent high-performance tensor network computations.
